next_item_hypothesis: A demonstrated failure mode is collapsing directed next-item transitions into item-similarity neighborhoods: the train-only population has 339519 directed transitions and 314605 with no observed reverse event (0.9266197178950221), while some frequent edges are reciprocal (22372↔22639; 9218↔22372). A single flat metric can spend code capacity on broad near-neighbor structure and fail to preserve the many one-way successor branches. Stage2 will encode item content plus train-only successor structure in a globally balanced, three-level residual SID; hyperbolic squared distance is hypothesized to better separate distinct outward branches while retaining shared broad prefixes. This is a hypothesis, not a causal conclusion from the manifest. Stage3 T5 alone ranks next items; Stage2 emits fixed item SIDs and does not rank.

math_definition.geometry_constants: Freeze curvature c=1.0 for the curved arm, tau=0.1 for the global Sinkhorn kernel, epsilon=1e-5 for the common projection radius R=1-epsilon=0.99999, clamp arcosh input to at least exactly 1.0, and use the stable arcosh(z)=log1p((z-1)+sqrt((z-1)*(z+1))). No clamp to 1+delta is used (delta=0). The scored distance is squared in both arms.

operator.flat_limit: As c->0, D_c^2(x,y)->4*||x-y||^2 and d_c(x,y)->2*||x-y||; the objective uses D_c^2, not d_c.
operator.c_to_zero_rules: For every distance invocation use the explicit continuous branch D_0^2=4*||x-y||^2; the exponential map exp_0(v)=v (identity); the projection-radius expression (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined at c=0, so the flat arm instead applies the identical fixed Euclidean norm projection ||x||<=R to every scored vector. No curvature-dependent projection occurs inside the scored region.

math_definition.shared_representation_and_operation_orde: Content embedding e_i is mapped by the same learned 32-dimensional map to h_i and projected to norm <=R. At each level l=1,2,3: map the current residual to the common tangent-coordinate representation; project that mapped vector to norm <=R; compute squared distances to all 256 level-l code vectors (each code vector is projected to norm <=R before scoring); compute full-training-population balanced soft assignments; form quantized vector q_il as the assignment-weighted sum of projected code vectors; subtract q_il from the current residual; project the residual to norm <=R before it is used by the next level. Thus every residual step is exactly map, project, assign, subtract, project-residual. The final exported SID is the global argmax code at each level from the frozen whole-training-item assignment table, one three-token SID per item, reused identically in all contexts. The soft assignment used in training is differentiable; the exported hard codes do not define a loss.
math_definition.balanced_assignment: At each epoch and level, compute costs for every training item in a fixed canonical item-ID order, never per minibatch. Compute the entropic transport matrix A_l over the entire training item set I_train by Sinkhorn scaling exp(-cost/tau), with each item row sum 1 and each of 256 code-column sums |I_train|/256; use 50 deterministic alternating row/column normalizations in float64, then cast the resulting matrix to model dtype. Freeze A_l for that epoch; minibatch composition never enters it. No validation/test item or behavior enters this assignment. For level 2, compute assignment after the level-1 residuals using the same global population. Global column balance at both levels and the fixed full-population assignment avoid the batch-hard-argmin diversity collapse; the level-two anti-collapse term explicitly rewards broad joint (k1,k2) occupancy. No claim of guaranteed prefix threshold is made; it is an evaluated gate.

objective.anti_collapse: The differentiable anti-collapse mechanism is a joint level-one/level-two occupancy entropy reward, plus global balanced assignment. It enters the minimized objective as -lambda_pc*H(p12), where p12 is the normalized soft joint assignment mass over all training items and 256^2 pairs; lambda_pc=0.01. Because H is maximized, mapping every item to one code pair cannot minimize this term. The same term and coefficient are used in both geometry arms.

loss_equations.name: global_balanced_soft_assignment
loss_equations.equation: For level l and i in I_train, C_l[i,k]=D_c^2(project(r_il),project(e_lk)); K_l=exp(-C_l/tau); A_l=Sinkhorn50(K_l; row_sum=1, column_sum=|I_train|/256), where assignments are computed on the entire canonical-order training item set in float64 and frozen for the epoch. q_il=sum_{k=1}^{256} A_l[i,k]*project(e_lk).
loss_equations.shapes_and_indices: C_l,K_l,A_l: [N_train,256]; r_il and q_il: [N_train,32]; e_lk: [256,32]; l in {1,2,3}.
loss_equations.empty_group_rule: I_train is the fixed nonempty training item population; an empty level/group is a fatal invalid run, not silently skipped.
loss_equations.gradient_and_circularity: The costs and learned code vectors have gradients through the exponential kernel and differentiable Sinkhorn normalizations. For stable epoch-frozen assignments, A_l is stop-gradient after whole-population computation; reconstruction and commitment losses still train encoder/codebook via their explicit paths. The assignment is computed from current-epoch parameters before that epoch's minibatch updates, so no target depends circularly on the same minibatch's update.

loss_equations.name: reconstruction_commitment
loss_equations.shapes_and_indices: h_i,r_il,q_il in R^32; one scalar per item, averaged over I_train; levels l={1,2,3}.
loss_equations.empty_group_rule: N_train=0 is fatal; otherwise ordinary arithmetic mean.
loss_equations.gradient_and_circularity: Reconstruction differentiates through encoder, soft assignment and code vectors; commitment differentiates through residual/encoder but stops the q target. q is formed from the epoch-frozen global assignment table, so no same-step target-parameter circularity.

loss_equations.name: train_successor_edge_loss
loss_equations.equation: For E_train={(i,j): count_train(i->j)>0}, define t_ij=softmax_k(-stopgrad(D_c^2(project(h_i),project(e_1k)))/tau) and s_ij=softmax_k(-D_c^2(project(h_j),project(e_1k))/tau); L_edge=-(1/|E_train|)*sum_{(i,j) in E_train} w_ij*sum_{k=1}^{256} t_ij[k]*log(max(s_ij[k],1e-12)), with w_ij=count_train(i->j)/sum_{(a,b) in E_train}count_train(a->b).
loss_equations.shapes_and_indices: h_i,h_j,e_1k in R^32; t_ij,s_ij in R^256; E_train contains unique directed transitions derived only from legal train-split interactions; counts are train-only.
loss_equations.empty_group_rule: If E_train is empty, define L_edge=0 and record no edge supervision; otherwise normalize by total unique edge count for the outer mean and by total train transition count for w.
loss_equations.gradient_and_circularity: The source target t is stop-gradient; the destination distribution s differentiates through destination representation, code vectors and D. This target is based only on the source item representation and is detached, preventing target-prediction circularity. No validation/test interactions, future events, prediction-time user context or batch composition are used.

loss_equations.name: level2_prefix_anti_collapse
loss_equations.shapes_and_indices: A_1,A_2 in R^(N_train x 256); p12 in R^(256 x 256); sum over all 65536 pairs.
loss_equations.empty_group_rule: N_train=0 is fatal; zero-mass cells contribute zero by 0*log(max(0,1e-12))=0.
loss_equations.gradient_and_circularity: Gradients pass through soft A_1 and A_2 to encoder and codebooks. The assignments are the frozen epoch-level global transport plan, not a target estimated from the current minibatch; no circular minibatch target.

loss_equations.name: total_stage2_loss
loss_equations.shapes_and_indices: Scalar objective; all item and edge index sets are defined above.
loss_equations.empty_group_rule: Uses the explicit L_edge empty-set rule above; other empty training populations are fatal.
loss_equations.gradient_and_circularity: All terms have explicit differentiable parameter paths as specified above; no loss is computed solely from one-hot argmin codes.

math_definition.loss_equations: The complete minimized objective is exactly L_rc + 0.1*L_edge + L_pc as defined in objective.loss_equations.

hyperbolic_necessity: The selected measured failure is directed successor-branch conflation: 92.66197178950221% of observed directed pairs lack a reverse event, with highly repeated directional edges alongside a few reciprocal pairs. Negative curvature is justified as a testable inductive bias because a tree-like, expanding neighborhood geometry can represent shared coarse identity followed by increasingly separated asymmetric branches, matching three-level residual codes and avoiding a single flat neighborhood's pressure to conflate branches. The evidence establishes directional structure only; it does not establish that negative curvature improves prediction, that the structure is intrinsically hierarchical, or that the literature combines hyperbolic geometry with TIGER. The verified TIGER abstract supports session next-item prediction with generative Semantic IDs only.
euclidean_control: Both arms use the same implementation, architecture, 32-dimensional representations, codebooks, initialization, global full-training-set balanced assignments, fixed norm projection radius R=0.99999, residual ordering, loss terms, training inputs, and frozen training protocol; only the scored operator changes from D_c^2 to its exact c->0 limit 4*||x-y||^2. The flat arm uses the same projection (not the undefined (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) expression).
effect_site: Squared-distance evaluation in the levelwise global assignment costs and transition edge distributions; same metric substitution in reconstruction and commitment. No Stage3 component is changed.
real_trigger_measurement: The behavior-trigger measurement is train-only directed successor asymmetry: no_reverse_fraction=0.9266197178950221 among 339519 directed transitions, from train_only_longest_prefix_per_user. It motivates a branch-encoding test, not a causal claim. Validation diagnostics use the prescribed frozen 52855-pair sample only; validation interactions never supervise training.
training_only_inputs: Stage2 consumes content embeddings and train-split item transitions only. No validation/test behavior, unseen future/test interactions, prediction-time user context, user bootstrap, or minibatch composition signal is allowed. The deterministic global assignment population is the full training item set, computed and frozen per epoch.

protocol.training_budget: unchanged full Stage2 budget; no early stopping
protocol.optimizer_schedule_batch_seed_codebook_i: exactly the existing frozen Stage2 run settings and KMeans-initialized codebook initialization, identical in both arms; do not alter or tune any of them
protocol.stage2_role: build one global three-token SID per item only; no prefix Transformer, beam search, recommendation ranking, Recall/NDCG computation, or user bootstrap
protocol.stage3_role: downstream frozen Stage3 T5 ranks next items after Stage2 admission

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_hard_er
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved strictly above frozen Resample gate
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Compute on the frozen validation pairs: 52855 anchors, one positive and ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] to target. Use valid Hard-L1 ER=10*positive_hits/negative_hits with negative hits counted over the same ten negatives. Gate is strict > registered minimum_effect.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.direction: curved strictly above frozen Resample gate
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Count unique (k1,k2) over all items for each arm; gate is strict > registered minimum_effect.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_positive_hit_rate
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: On the same frozen 52855 validation pairs, report the share where anchor first SID token equals positive first SID token; compare paired seed-wise curved minus flat.

stage2_diagnostics.name: l3_collision
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Share of all items whose full three-code SID is shared with another item; compare paired seed-wise curved minus flat.

stage2_diagnostics.name: l3_refinement_gain
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Mean over items of log2(|bucket(k1,k2)|/|bucket(k1,k2,k3)|); compare paired seed-wise curved minus flat.

stage2_diagnostics.name: conditional_g3
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Use exactly alpha=1 and K=256. For each validation pair compute p_pref(l)=(target-prefix bucket items with third code l, minus one if l is target's own third code, plus alpha)/(bucket size minus one plus alpha*K); p_hist(l)=(train-only longest-prefix successor count restricted to target's level-two prefix and third code l plus alpha*p_pref(l))/(restricted successor total plus alpha). Average log2(p_hist(target third code)/p_pref(target third code)); pair with no restricted successor contributes 0; non-finite pair is NULL. Compare paired seed-wise curved minus flat.

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: Only after both Stage2 arms pass the frozen admission gates, run the unchanged Stage3 T5 protocol and evaluate test_R@10 on the existing held-out test split; paired seeds and identical Stage3 settings. No test data may be used for Stage2 choices or training.

classification.falsified_if: any registered Stage2 admission diagnostic fails its stated strict gate, OR every defined Stage2 geometry diagnostic is not in its registered direction, OR stage3_behavioral_test is defined and is not in its registered direction
classification.passed_if: both registered Stage2 admission diagnostics pass their strict gates AND every other registered Stage2 diagnostic and stage3_behavioral_test meet their registered direction and minimum_effect, with no NULL seed
classification.mixed_if: otherwise; this includes any NULL outcome or comparison containing a NULL seed, which is inconclusive and is neither passed nor falsified

falsifier.null_outcome_rule: If any seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (including zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum), classify that outcome NULL. Any comparison with any NULL seed is inconclusive, not passed or falsified.
